chapter.title: OF FALSE EVIDENCE AND OFFENCES AGAINST PUBLIC JUSTICE

heading: Offering gift or restoration of property in consideration of screening offender.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)

amendment_history.footnote_text: Subs. by Act 42 of 1953, s. 4 and the Third Sch., for “to restore or cause the restoration of”.
Subs. by Act 26 of 1955, s. 117 and the Sch., for “transportation for life” (w.e.f. 1-1-1956).
Subs. by Act 8 of 1882, s. 6, for the original Exception.
Illustrations rep. by Act 10 of 1882, s. 2 and the First Sch.
